channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: Chennai Turbo Riders secures Team title at F4 C’ship
item.description: Despite the title being decided, Chandaria and Rotge continued their rivalry in Race 2. With the reverse grid pushing them down the order, both drivers fought through the field to finish on the podium.

item.title: Gold, silver prices jump on MCX amid weak dollar, global cues
item.description: Silver March contracts also saw strong buying interest and climbed 1.36 per cent to Rs 1,95,466 per kg.

item.title: Aus PM Albanese proposes tougher national gun laws after mass shooting in Sydney
item.description: At least 38 people were being treated in hospitals after the massacre on Sunday, when the two shooters fired indiscriminately on the beachfront festivities. Those killed included a 10-year-old girl, a rabbi and a Holocaust survivor.

item.title: Leonardo DiCaprio: I would never want to direct
item.description: The Oscar winner, who has made six films with Scorsese to date, went on to describe their unique creative process, noting that they have “months” of prep and discussion before shooting begins.

item.title: Shooting of Madhavan's eagerly awaited film 'G.D.N' wrapped up!
item.description: Directed by Krishnakumar Ramakumar, 'G.D.N.' has been backed by Varghese Moolan Pictures in collaboration with Tricolour Films.

item.title: Lok Sabha adjourned till 12 noon amid protests by treasury over 'threat' by Cong workers to PM
item.description: When the House met at 11 AM after the weekend break, Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla first paid tributes to three former members of the House who passed away in the recent past.

item.title: IndiGo cancels most Tiruchy–Chennai flights from December 16, retains only two daily services
item.description: The move is aimed at providing more seats to passengers, as Airbus aircraft have a higher seating capacity compared to ATR planes, said a Daily Thanthi report.

item.title: RBI to banks: Link MSME loans to external benchmark
item.description: Further, to make the benefit of external benchmark-based interest regime available to existing borrowers, banks have been advised to provide a switch over option as per mutually agreed terms.

item.title: BMW plans to expand MINI portfolio in India
item.description: The company, which now has MINI Cooper, MINI Countryman JCW and MINI Convertible in its portfolio, is looking to expand its sales network in smaller cities and towns as the brand gains acceptance beyond major cities.

item.title: Ola Electric starts hyperdelivery in Bengaluru
item.description: This is a part of its umbrella Hyperservice initiative to deliver a transparent, convenient, and customer-first service experience, the Bengaluru-based firm said.
